content_sections.heading: CMHO Raigarh Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. C.S.R./2026/31652 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CMHO Raigarh notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Intermediate (10+2); Diploma of certified course in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent Age limit: Minimum 18 years and maximum 70 years (for medical posts) (as on 1 January 2026) Desirable: One year experience in NTEP or Sputum smear microscopy. Candidates with higher qualification will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for CMHO Raigarh Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates whose service was ended by the National Health Mission or any government department for indiscipline, financial irregularity or misconduct

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is purely on a contract basis for 1 year under NHM / NTEP.

content_sections.heading: How Will CMHO Raigarh Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in submission of application Written Exam Skill Test / Interview Academic qualification - 65% marks Experience marks - 10/15 marks Written / skill test / interview - 20 marks

content_sections.heading: CMHO Raigarh Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Written test on 13-11-2026, 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM; result at 03:00 PM

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: 10th marksheet for age proof 12th marksheet Essential educational degree/diploma marksheet of all years Live registration certificate in concerned council Caste / Domicile certificate Identity card such as Aadhar card, voter ID, PAN card, driving license Work experience certificate with appointment order

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMHO Raigarh Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in venue with the application form in the prescribed format attached to the notification. Submit the application along with self-attested copies of all necessary documents on the date of walk-in. Attend on 12 November 2026, reporting at 9:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in.
